name: file-upload

chunks.content: upload a file to S3 using boto3: client.upload_fileobj(file, bucket, key, ExtraArgs={'ContentType': content_type})
generate a presigned S3 URL for temporary read access: client.generate_presigned_url('get_object', Params={'Bucket': bucket, 'Key': key}, ExpiresIn=3600)
create a database backup by dumping all tables to a SQL file with pg_dump
use multipart upload for files over 5MB: initiate, upload parts in parallel, then complete the multipart upload

prompt: how do I upload large files to S3 efficiently
